name: ogbg-ppa: Protein-Protein Association Graph Classification
description: The ogbg-ppa dataset is a graph classification benchmark composed of 158,100 protein-protein association (PPA) subgraphs extracted from the STRING database across 1,581 species. Each graph corresponds to a protein network where nodes represent proteins and edges represent biological associations with 7-dimensional weight features. The task is 37-way multi-class classification to identify the taxonomic group/species from which each protein network was sampled, evaluated under a scaffold/taxonomic out-of-distribution split.
